title: STRiDE pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.input. One row per tumor/normal pair; BAI indexes are auto-discovered next to each BAM (sample.bam.bai or sample.bai).

sample_id.errorMessage: sample_id must be provided and cannot contain spaces

tumor_bam.errorMessage: tumor_bam must be a path to a .bam file and cannot contain spaces

normal_bam.errorMessage: normal_bam must be a path to a .bam file and cannot contain spaces
normal_bam.description: Path to the matched normal BAM

matched_norm_sample_barcode.description: Normal sample identifier (e.g. P-0012345-N01-XS1). Defaults to the normal BAM basename when empty.
